174Hz Nervous System Reset: Release All Stored Tension, Cleanse All Negative Energy
Allow your body and mind to completely unwind with this deeply soothing 174Hz healing session. The 174Hz frequency is naturally aligned to relieve physical tension, quiet an overactive nervous system, and clear out accumulated stress and negative energy.
Whether you are looking to recover from a stressful day, prepare for restful sleep, or support your daily meditation practice, this soundscape is designed to help you let go of what no longer serves you and restore a sense of inner peace.
